args.title: Fix issue 4406 in src/ingest/parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

The issue is explained in src/ingest/parser.ts where parseStatement parses statement lines and asserts the row shape. The code pops a final empty string line if present, but if the last line is truly empty (only newline), the parser still processes it and throws 'Malformed row' error on the blank last line. The fix is to better handle trailing blank lines before processing rows.
